text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after tryouts, I catch sight of
Special Week at the school
cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that was delicious! Phew, nothing
beats a nice carrot hamburger
steak!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Their carrot sauté was great too! Oh, and
the carrot yakisoba! Even
the carrot gratin!
Carrots galore! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I'm surprised you're able to say that
after three servings of,
well... everything! I
dunno how you do it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And if we look over here... Helloooo? El?
Still alive?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Urk... I could only keep up with you until
your second serving, but
three? You really
are something else, Spe...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... El?! Are you feeling all right?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You just noticed? She's been like this for a
while now. You gotta pay
more attention
to your surroundings, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, El? We have a scrimmage after this...
Are you going to be okay?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
D-don't worry about me! Just a bit full,
that's all. I'm the invincible
condor...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'll get better before we start our race!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trying to get a lead before the race even
begins, huh? I gotta say,
Spe, you're quite
the tactician.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I am not! C'mon, El! Please pull yourself together!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I told you... I'm fine! Burp.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, Spe, you don't need to say
please every time something
happens!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I thought I told you to quit being so tense!
Loosen up a bit! Talk to
me like you would
to any other classmate!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You did say that, didn't ya? I thought it
was funny to hear coming
from you,
though. You're just as polite as she is!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's just easier for me to be this way! But
enough about me! It's Spe
we're talking
about now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I guess... you're right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I just don't wanna sound rude or
anything. I get super nervous
when I talk
to people, so I end up being too polite.
It's a bad habit, I
know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was worried that I wouldn't be able to
get along with anybody,
y'know?
Especially at the start, ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's your first time being around other girls
your age, not to mention
other
Umamusume, right? You sure are shy for
someone so friendly!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ya gotta kick back and relax once in a
while! Live a little, y'know?
Just take it
from me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: How about we ditch class and go fishing?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Kick back and... relax? Like you do? I'm
not sure that's really...
possible?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, who worries about having fun?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week enjoys a hearty meal with
her friends, lost in
conversation from the
first to the very last bite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week finally notices my presence
and runs over to me to chat.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Have you tried the carrot
hamburger steak? It's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe food this delicious is free!
And all-you-can-eat too!
Tracen Academy
sure pulls out all the stops!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And the cherry on top is being able to eat
with my friends! Ehehe...
I'm so glad I could
enroll here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! El and Sei... Grass and King too...
They're all so nice to me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I grew up alone with my mom, so ever
since I was little, I wanted a
friend I could
talk to or run with!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So being able to chat with my friends and
compete with each other
like this is like a
dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I sent my mom a letter
with a picture of me and my
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She was super happy about it! She told me
that she even ran all the
way over to our
neighbors to show them!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But our closest neighbors live, like, five
kilometers away from us,
y'know? Mom
sure does love to get worked up over
nothin'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week happily continues to tell me
about her mother and
hometown. It seems
like she doesn't really have any problems
with her
life here at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that day, while out on a walk, I spot
a stressed student raising
her voice at
Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... S-sorry, could you say that again?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Once more then! I'm asking why you pulled
that crazy stunt during our
scrimmage
yesterday! If you had just stayed put, I
would've won!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I-I also wanted to win, so
y'know...

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text: But you already have your own trainer!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
So why'd you have to do that?! Couldn't
you have just let me win?!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I don't have much time left! I gotta get
scouted soon, or else I might
not get
scouted at all! I won't be able to make it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Won't be able to make it?" W-what do
you mean?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
It's my mom. She's been in and out of the
hospital for as long as I can
remember. But
lately, she's been getting worse. Even her
doctor is
seriously worried.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
She's been waiting ages for me to make my
debut! She's the one who
pushed me this
far... But at this rate, I won't be able to
make it in
time...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Th-that's awful...

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
So please, Spe... Let me win the next
scrimmage, okay? That'd be
okay, right?!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text: We're friends... aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Class is starting soon. Let's get going,
Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okay...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that day, Special Week runs in
another scrimmage race. Her
usual grit and
energy are missing, however, and she ends
up in
seventh place.
